1.w: Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good, and his loyal love endures.

2.w: Let those delivered by the Lord speak out, those whom he delivered from the power of the enemy

3.w: and gathered from foreign lands, from east and west, from north and south.

4.w: They wandered through the wilderness, in a wasteland; they found no road to a city in which to live.

5.w: They were hungry and thirsty; they fainted from exhaustion.

6.w: They cried out to the Lord in their distress; he delivered them from their troubles.

7.w: He led them on a level road that they might find a city in which to live.

8.w: Let them give thanks to the Lord for his loyal love and for the amazing things he has done for people.

9.w: For he has satisfied those who thirst, and those who hunger he has filled with food.

10.w: They sat in utter darkness, bound in painful iron chains

11.w: because they had rebelled against God’s commands and rejected the instructions of the Most High.

12.w: So he used suffering to humble them; they stumbled and no one helped them up.

13.w: They cried out to the Lord in their distress; he delivered them from their troubles.

14.w: He brought them out of the utter darkness and tore off their shackles.

15.w: Let them give thanks to the Lord for his loyal love and for the amazing things he has done for people.

16.w: For he shattered the bronze gates and hacked through the iron bars.

17.w: They acted like fools in their rebellious ways and suffered because of their sins.

18.w: They lost their appetite for all food, and they drew near the gates of death.

19.w: They cried out to the Lord in their distress; he delivered them from their troubles.

20.w: He sent them an assuring word and healed them; he rescued them from the pits where they were trapped.

21.w: Let them give thanks to the Lord for his loyal love and for the amazing things he has done for people.

22.w: Let them present thank offerings, and loudly proclaim what he has done.

23.w: Some traveled on the sea in ships and carried cargo over the vast waters.

24.w: They witnessed the acts of the Lord , his amazing feats on the deep water.

25.w: He gave the order for a windstorm, and it stirred up the waves of the sea.

26.w: They reached up to the sky, then dropped into the depths. The sailors’ strength left them because the danger was so great.

27.w: They swayed and staggered like drunks, and all their skill proved ineffective.

28.w: They cried out to the Lord in their distress; he delivered them from their troubles.

29.w: He calmed the storm, and the waves grew silent.

30.w: The sailors rejoiced because the waves grew quiet, and he led them to the harbor they desired.

31.w: Let them give thanks to the Lord for his loyal love and for the amazing things he has done for people.

32.w: Let them exalt him in the assembly of the people. Let them praise him in the place where the leaders preside.

33.w: He turned streams into a desert, springs of water into arid land,

34.w: and a fruitful land into a barren place, because of the sin of its inhabitants.

35.w: As for his people, he turned a desert into a pool of water and a dry land into springs of water.

36.w: He allowed the hungry to settle there, and they established a city in which to live.

37.w: They cultivated fields and planted vineyards, which yielded a harvest of fruit.

38.w: He blessed them so that they became very numerous. He would not allow their cattle to decrease in number.

39.w: As for their enemies, they decreased in number and were beaten down, because of painful distress and suffering.

40.w: He would pour contempt upon princes, and he made them wander in a wasteland with no road.

41.w: Yet he protected the needy from oppression and cared for his families like a flock of sheep.

42.w: When the godly see this, they rejoice, and every sinner shuts his mouth.

43.w: Whoever is wise, let him take note of these things. Let them consider the Lord ’s acts of loyal love.
